traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Ranunculales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral; opposite in Clematis only (general knowledge).

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Ranunculales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral.

traits.division_pattern.note: APweb, Ranunculales page (read 2026-10-16): Papaveraceae lobed or compound with palmate venation; Ranunculaceae lobing mostly palmate (Ranunculus, Aconitum, Delphinium; weighting inferred).

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Ranunculales page (read 2026-10-16): woody Berberidaceae, Menispermaceae, Lardizabalaceae, Euptelea leafy-stemmed; basal rosettes in herbaceous Ranunculaceae and Papaveraceae (state their own).

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Ranunculales page (read 2026-10-16): herbs, shrubs, lianas, Euptelea deciduous trees; annuals mostly in Papaveraceae and Ranunculaceae.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Ranunculales page (read 2026-10-16): Papaveraceae inflorescences terminal; Euptelea axillary. Terminal 'usually' weighted by the herbaceous majority (inferred).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Ranunculales page (read 2026-10-16): monosymmetry arose at least twice (Fumarioideae, Delphinieae); most flowers regular.

traits.zygomorphy.note: APweb, Ranunculales page (read 2026-10-16): zygomorphic flowers are spurred (Fumarioideae, larkspurs) or hooded (monkshoods), not two-lipped or pea plans.

traits.perianth.note: APweb, Ranunculales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): petals present in nearly all; Euptelea may lack a perianth.

traits.corolla_shape.note: APweb, Ranunculales page (read 2026-10-16): petals free, deciduous; Ranunculaceae saucer flowers (rotate) and Papaver bowls (cupped). Weighting inferred.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Ranunculales page (read 2026-10-16): no floral cup described; all families with candidates state false or mostly false.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Ranunculales page (read 2026-10-16): carpels free or connate on the receptacle; superior throughout.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Ranunculales page (read 2026-10-16): Papaveraceae and Euptelea bisexual; Menispermaceae (dioecious) state their own.
